summary: Both prior REJECT findings are closed in the actual tree, not just the diff, and the fixes introduce no new divergence. (1) plugins/shipwright-build/scripts/hooks/write-review-payload-on-stop.py: salvage_path() now returns CANONICAL_BASENAME[review_type] (spec_review_reply.json / code_review_reply.json / doubt_review_reply.json, byte-identical to lib.review_payloads.CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_BASENAMES); docstring rewritten. tests/test_review_payload_on_stop.py goes through hook.salvage_path() everywhere (no literal name); tests/test_review_payload_hook_wiring_integration.py mirrors the dict. A repo-wide grep for '_salvaged_raw' hits only historical .shipwright/ artifacts -- no tracked code, test, or skill prose. iteration-reviews.md now says the hook salvages to the same canonical basename. (2) campaign-mode.md names the three canonical basenames + trg-3b206c08 at the 3f-bis spawn site, and its spec example uses the canonical path; consistent with the other producer sites -- iteration-reviews.md, iteration-planning.md, sub-iterate-runner.md. Clobber check: the hook fires synchronously on SubagentStop before the Task result reaches the orchestrator, writes only when reviews.json shows no terminal row, and the orchestrator's later write is the same reply to the same path -- a harmless overwrite. No test hardcodes the old name. Fresh scan for other producers: pr_review_generated.py is untouched as the task requires. Non-blocking notes for Stage 2 (not spec divergences): stale architecture.md historical entry, pre-existing hooks-and-pipeline.md inaccuracy unrelated to this diff, remaining generic '<reply>' placeholders in remediation hints, and an out-of-scope legacy W2 marker. Code-reviewer may proceed.
